segments.name: TotalStone
segments.description: Wholesale distribution of thin veneer and natural and manufactured stone products through Instone and Canadian Stone Industries across the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: The Company has two reportable segments: (i) the TotalStone segment, which includes the operations of TotalStone, LLC and Canadian Stone Industries

segments.name: Carolina Stone
segments.description: Distributes and installs thin veneer stone and related masonry products for residential, commercial, and multi-family projects in the Southeast U.S.
segments.evidence: Carolina Stone distributes and installs thin veneer stone and related masonry products for residential, commercial, and multi-family projects in the Southeast United States from two locations in North Carolina.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from wholesale distribution and installation of stone and masonry products sold to masonry dealers, contractors, builders, and homeowners.
revenueModel.evidence: Together, our platform offers over 3,000 SKUs across nine warehouse and distribution center locations, serving a diverse base of masonry dealers, contractors, builders, and homeowners.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired Carolina Stone Holdings, creating the Carolina Stone segment.
changes.evidence: On August 22, 2025, through its indirect subsidiary CS Purchase Holdings, LLC, the Company acquired 100% of the membership interests of Carolina Stone Holdings, LLC ("CSH").

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired Fraser Canyon Holdings and Continental Stone Industries, expanding the TotalStone segment into Canada and the U.S. West Coast.
changes.evidence: This acquisition marked the Company's entry into the Canadian market and the U.S. West Coast, and is reported within the Company's Instone/TotalStone segment.
